name: Chino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chino city emblem in black: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Chino, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 September 1958.

features.role: Chino city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter M
